prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bedroom realistic selfie vlog style with slight motion blur and graininess, like an iPhone snapshot with low image quality but authentic daily charm. An adult Asian woman with cold-white skin, vintage side-swept bangs, and fluffy half-tied long hair sits cross-legged on the bed, facing the imaginary phone camera. She wears a winter oversized sweater layered over a simple camisole, with a relaxed everyday fit. She makes random natural poses: tilting her head and winking, resting her chin on her hand and pouting, stroking her hair and laughing, then suddenly covering her face shyly. The bedroom is slightly messy, with pillows placed randomly and clothes draped on a chair. Use natural light and warm lamp light, shallow depth of field, mainly upper-body close-ups with occasional full-body small movements. Emphasize accidental daily-vlog snapshot feeling, visible grain, realistic motion, and cute adult charm.
